title: Cedar Smoke Soy Candle, Woodsmoke and Cedar Scent, Hand Poured, Amber Glass Jar
description:
Come here, you've got to smell this one. Cedar Smoke is a hand-poured soy candle that smells like a campfire after it settles down -- real cedar, real woodsmoke, a little sweet underneath. If you've ever wanted your living room to feel like a cabin in November, this is the one.

SCENT: cedar, woodsmoke, a touch of sweetness
VESSEL: 8oz amber glass jar, fits on any shelf
WAX & WICK: natural soy wax, cotton wick
BURN TIME: around 45 hours
MADE: hand-poured by me, in small batches
CARE: trim the wick to 1/4 inch before lighting, and let the first burn pool all the way across

Ships in 1-3 business days, wrapped so it arrives the way it left.
